dict.string: One-shot escrow snapshotter for /cold-storage. Iterates the Ripple monthly-release cohort in named_accounts.json (minus the RLUSD issuer) via account_objects(type=escrow), routed through xrpl_client.get_client() so a load-shedding local rippled cascades to s1/s2. Replaces the escrows_snapshot table in Neon each pass; the /cold-storage route reads via escrow_snapshot.py (5-min TTL). TokenEscrow adoption in the cohort is auto-surfaced by inspecting Amount shape — no separate build. v1 = replace-on-write; append-with-history door is marked in escrow_walker.py if a realized-releases chart is ever wanted.
